note: Looks from athletelook.PlayerLook(SchoolKit(school), Slot, 2112) as cmd/bakeathletes/silhouette.go calls it. wearers: the two named wearers (first school). roster: every school, positions OL DL TE LB RB WR CB QB S, depth 0..2. Written by a throwaway cmd/lookdump in a scratch copy of the game tree (HEAD b79b609 with the other lanes' uncommitted changes as they stood), run on a Mac. Values are rounded to 6 decimals. The roster is a table to keep the file small: roster_columns names the columns; 'joint:X' is joint_scales[X] and 'weight:X' is shape_weights[X]; a roster slot has no number. Regenerate it the same way when the game's looks change.
